notes: The prompt calls itself an exploration game and the answers give it an Adventure objective — explore the park, repair the coaster, find the clues that explain the shutdown — so Adventure leads, with Survival named second for the eerie horror framing and the unknown creatures in the tunnel, which is the one thing only its spawner-npc can place. The answers put all nine locations on one continuous few-hundred-stud park, so this is world-open on the Exploration preset rather than separate zones: the Ferris wheel is the focal landmark, the hidden passages and locked booths are alcove-secret and gate-progression, and the clues, tickets and coaster parts are collectible-nodes. P3 is stated outright — the hall of mirrors, circus tent, booths, control room and tunnel are all entered from the surface — and P2 comes with them, because the tunnel runs beneath the park and the Ferris wheel is climbed to the map's high point, so play surfaces genuinely sit above each other. I left Puzzle unnamed to stay at two genres, since the hall of mirrors is content inside one interior, and the food-cart hangout has no option in the loaded files, so it is placed as dressing on the midway.
